name: Game of Life
recipe: Conway's Game of Life — the iconic B3/S23 automaton: gliders sail, blinkers pulse, guns spew, still-lifes settle and chaotic soups boil into structure. Seed dense soups + planted glider-guns so the frame stays perpetually active; reseed regions that die out. Default COLORFUL: living cells by AGE through a vivid ramp (new=hot -> old=cool), a fading ghost-trail of recently-dead cells, on dark. Luminance ~0.18-0.45, edge-to-edge.
kernel: coarse bit grid in S (<=200 wide); each frame apply B3/S23 with a neighbor count; keep an age buffer (frames-alive) + a decaying death-trail buffer; render via LUT (age->hue, trail->dim) into pixels[] buffer, upscale. Reseed low-density regions with random soup / glider guns on K.section. K.t gates step rate.
style: age-plasma (default, age-ramp cells + ghost trails). Also: phosphor (green CRT), heatmap (density thermal), neon (cyan live/magenta dying), ink (named mono, black cells on cream).

name: Ising Spin Domains
recipe: The 2D Ising model near critical temperature: up/down magnetic spins flip by Metropolis rule, forming and dissolving fractal domains and coarsening boundaries — magnetization fluctuating, domain walls writhing. Sweep temperature slowly on K.section through the critical point so the texture morphs from frozen order to critical filigree to hot noise. Default COLORFUL: two spin phases as a duotone (indigo vs gold) with glowing domain walls, luminance ~0.2-0.5, edge-to-edge.
kernel: coarse spin grid (+/-1) in S (<=200 wide); each frame do many Metropolis flips (dE from 4 neighbors, accept if dE<0 or rnd<exp(-dE/T)); T drifts on K.section around Tc~2.27; render spins via duotone LUT + highlight domain-wall pixels (neighbor mismatch). K.t gates flip count.
style: duotone-walls (default, indigo/gold + glowing walls). Also: thermal (magnetization heat), monochrome (named, b/w spins), neon (walls only on black), copper (patina duotone).

name: Invasion Percolation
recipe: Invasion percolation: fluid invades a random-threshold medium always through the weakest available pore, growing a ramified fractal cluster with trapped voids — the geology of oil/water fingering. Grow perpetually; when the cluster fills, dissolve and regrow on a new random medium. Default COLORFUL: invaded cluster colored by invasion-TIME through an iq palette (early violet -> late gold), untouched medium dark, trapped voids darker. Luminance ~0.18-0.45, spreads to fill frame.
kernel: random threshold grid + a growing cluster + a frontier min-heap (or repeated scan) in S (<=180 wide); each frame invade the lowest-threshold frontier cells (many per frame), color newly-invaded by time; render via time->LUT into pixels[] buffer, upscale. Reset + new medium on K.section. Growing frontier is the motion.
style: time-flow (default, violet->gold invasion time). Also: oil-water (crude/brine duotone), thermal, moss (organic greens), ink (named mono, black cluster on cream).

name: Traffic Automaton
recipe: The Biham-Middleton-Levine traffic model: red cars move right, blue cars move down, each advancing only if the next cell is free — from random density it self-organizes into either free-flowing diagonal stripes or a gridlocked jam, a striking phase transition. Vary density on K.section to cross the jamming threshold so it flips between flow and gridlock. Default COLORFUL: red + blue cars (with a hint of intermediate hue at contested cells) on a dark road, luminance ~0.2-0.5, edge-to-edge.
kernel: coarse grid in S (<=200 wide) with cells {empty,red,blue}; alternate phases each step (all reds try to move right into empty, then all blues down); render red/blue/empty via LUT into pixels[] buffer, upscale. Density set on K.section (reseed). K.t gates step rate; the moving cars + emergent stripes/jams are the motion.
style: neon-traffic (default, red/blue cars on dark). Also: sodium-night (amber/cyan), heatmap (flow speed), blueprint (white cars on blue), mono (named, two greys).

name: Gumowski-Mira Attractor
recipe: The Gumowski-Mira attractor: a recurrence with a nonlinear f(x)=ax+2(1-a)x^2/(1+x^2) that produces astonishing organic forms — swirling mandalas, insectoid shells, galactic filaments — depending on parameters. Slowly drift a,b on K.t so the creature morphs between forms. Default COLORFUL: point density log-mapped through an iq palette (deep magenta low -> cyan/white high) glowing on dark, luminance ~0.12-0.35.
kernel: accumulate ~40-70k iterates into a coarse density buffer each frame (splat), map log(1+density) through a palette LUT, upscale. Drift a,b (and b0) slowly on K.t so the attractor perpetually reshapes; reseed start each frame. Keep it bright enough to read.
style: bioluminescent (default, magenta->cyan/white density). Also: gold-silk (indigo->gold), ember (blackbody), plasma (magenta/cyan), pencil (named mono, graphite on cream).

name: Hopalong Attractor
recipe: Barry Martin's 'Hopalong' attractor: x'=y-sign(x)*sqrt(|b*x-c|), y'=a-x iterated into vast swirling square-ish galactic sheets and interference-like curved lattices unique to this map. Drift a,b,c on K.t so the sheets rotate and re-weave. Default COLORFUL: density log-mapped through a palette (teal low -> amber high) glowing on dark, with the characteristic moire striations. Luminance ~0.12-0.35.
kernel: accumulate ~50-80k iterates into a coarse density buffer each frame, log-map through palette LUT, upscale. Drift a,b,c slowly on K.t. The overlapping curved sheets create natural moire; keep bright enough to read edge-to-edge.
style: teal-amber (default). Also: plasma (magenta/cyan), ember (blackbody), ice (blue/white), pencil (named mono, graphite).

name: Wang Tile Weave
recipe: An aperiodic Wang-tiling: colored-edge tiles placed so touching edges match, tiling the plane with a non-repeating pattern whose colored edges connect into continuous flowing paths/pipes across the frame. The tiling slowly re-rolls / scrolls on K.t so the pattern perpetually rewrites. Default COLORFUL: the connecting edge-paths as bright multi-hue ribbons/pipes over a dark tile grid, luminance ~0.2-0.5, edge-to-edge.
kernel: cache a valid Wang assignment (edge-matched) over the grid in S (rebuild on seed/density); each tile draws its edge-connections (arcs/pipes) colored by edge-type; slow K.t scroll + periodic single-tile re-roll (keeping validity) animates it. Draw connective paths so colors flow across tile boundaries.
style: pipes (default, bright edge-path ribbons on dark grid). Also: circuit (copper traces), stained-glass (filled tiles), op-art (2-color, named mono), neon (glow paths).

name: Buddhabrot
recipe: The Buddhabrot: accumulate the ESCAPE TRAJECTORIES of many random points through the Mandelbrot iteration — the density of visited pixels paints a ghostly, luminous, nebula-like apparition of the set's exterior dynamics. Accumulate over frames into a persistent density buffer (progressive refinement), slowly rotating/drifting the sample window on K.t so the phantom breathes. Default COLORFUL: density through a nebula palette (deep blue low -> cyan -> gold -> white high) on black, luminance ~0.12-0.35, fills frame.
kernel: persistent density buffer in S; each frame fire N random c-samples, iterate z=z^2+c, and IF it escapes, replot the whole trajectory splatting each visited point into the density buffer; tone-map log(density) through a palette LUT each frame. Slowly decay/rotate so it perpetually evolves (never fully static). Keep N modest for perf.
style: nebula (default, blue->cyan->gold->white density). Also: ember (blackbody), spectral (rainbow by escape-count channel), ghost (violet/white), bone (named mono, white on black).

name: Slit-Scan Time Smear
recipe: Slit-scan: each column (or row) of the frame samples a moving synthetic scene at a DIFFERENT time, smearing motion into liquid time-warped ribbons and taffy distortions — the classic slit-scan / rolling-shutter look. Default COLORFUL: the underlying scene is a drifting colorful noise/stripe field; the time-offset per column pulls it into flowing diagonal smears. Luminance ~0.2-0.5, fills frame.
kernel: keep a history buffer (ring of recent synthetic-scene columns) OR compute the source field sampled at time (K.t - x/width * span) per column so each column is a different moment; the source is a colorful drifting fbm/stripe field. Render per-column into a buffer, upscale. Continuous K.t = flowing smear.
style: chromatic-smear (default, spectral time-ribbons). Also: vhs-warp (chroma-split), thermal, aurora, mono (named, greyscale smear).

name: Coulomb Charges
recipe: A cloud of positive and negative charged particles interacting by Coulomb force (like repels, opposite attracts) self-organizes into pulsing ionic lattices, dipole chains and plasma clumps that continuously rearrange — a dancing electrostatic crystal. Softened forces + mild damping so it breathes without exploding. Default COLORFUL: + charges warm (red/gold), - charges cool (cyan/blue), glowing with faint force-line hints on dark; luminance ~0.15-0.35, fills frame.
kernel: particle array in S (pos,vel,charge; <=220) with softened pairwise Coulomb (O(N^2) fine at N<=220) + weak central confinement + damping; integrate; draw ADD glowing dots colored by charge + short trails into a fade buffer. Periodically perturb on K.section. Continuous rearrangement is the motion.
style: ionic (default, warm + / cool - glow). Also: plasma (violet/cyan), firefly (warm points), lattice-lines (draw near-neighbor bonds), mono (named, white points).
